title: ICC-ES ESR-1147: Integraspec insulating concrete forms (ICF)
jurisdiction: United States (ICC-ES evaluation report under IBC/IRC); NON-ALBERTA COMPARATIVE ONLY: cannot establish Alberta performance, acceptance or equivalence; no Canadian or Alberta approval is claimed or implied
code_edition: 2018, 2015, 2012 and 2009 IBC and IRC (report §1.1, p1); 2006 IBC/IRC addressed in §8.0; 2013 ADIBC (p1)
document_date: Reissued December 2025; CA supplement revised August 2026; continuous compliance through December 2026 (p1)

facts.text: Report holder INTEGRASPEC CORPORATION; evaluation subject is the Integraspec ICF system.
Use is limited to Type V construction (IBC Chapter 6) and to nonfire-resistance-rated construction under the IRC, 'except as described in Section 4.3'.
Types I-IV (noncombustible) use requires a label visible in every 160 sq ft (14.7 m2) of wall area before wall covering.
When the code official requires it, calculations for the §4.1.1 design must be submitted, prepared by a registered design professional where the jurisdiction's statutes require.
Integraspec ICFs are produced for Integraspec Corporation by APTCO LLC in McFarland, California.
Evidence: AC353 (October 2012, ed. December 2018) for the 2018/2015/2012 IBC and IRC; AC353 (October 2010) for the 2009 IBC and IRC.
